titleZh: 函数、导数与雅可比：描述变化如何传播
titleEn: Functions, derivatives, and Jacobians: how change propagates
title:
函数、导数与雅可比：描述变化如何传播

Functions, derivatives, and Jacobians: how change propagates

blocks.text: 导数的实际用途不是做孤立的极限题，而是预测变化。如果关节角稍微改变，机械臂末端会朝哪里移动、移动多少？如果损失函数变大，哪个参数最应该调整？导数和雅可比把这些问题写成局部可计算的变化关系；它们同时连接运动学、控制、优化、视觉伺服和机器学习。

The practical use of derivatives is not isolated limit exercises. Derivatives predict change. If joint angles change slightly, in which direction and by how much does the end-effector move? If a loss grows, which parameter should change? Derivatives and Jacobians make these questions locally computable and connect kinematics, control, optimization, visual servoing, and machine learning.

blocks.text: 3.1 函数：导数必须有输入、输出和单位 3.1 A function: a derivative needs inputs, outputs, and units
函数 $y=f(x)$ 把输入空间中的对象映射到输出空间。机器人正运动学就是函数：关节角 $q$ 经过机械结构得到末端位置 $p$。如果没有函数的输入、输出、frame 和单位，后面的导数就没有对象。

A function $y=f(x)$ maps an object from an input space to an output space. Forward kinematics is a function: joint angles $q$ pass through the mechanism to produce end-effector position $p$. Without the input, output, frame, and units of a function, its derivative has no object to describe.
这意味着 $\partial p/\partial q$ 的单位是 m/rad，而不是“没有单位的矩阵”。单位分析可以在控制增益、归一化和仿真接口中阻止很多错误：如果把一个 m/rad 的 Jacobian 当成 m/deg 使用，动作尺度会差一个 $180/\pi$。

Thus $\partial p/\partial q$ has units m/rad; it is not a unitless matrix. Unit analysis prevents errors in control gains, normalization, and simulation interfaces. Treating an m/rad Jacobian as m/deg changes the scale by $180/\pi$.
一个机器人函数至少应说明：

items: 输入变量的类型、形状、frame、unit 和合法范围；
输出变量的类型、形状、frame、unit 和时间含义；
连续性或可微性的假设；
在边界、奇异位形、NaN 或碰撞状态下的行为；
一个可手算的例子和一个自动化测试。

blocks.text: 3.2 一元导数：局部斜率与预测 3.2 One-variable derivatives: local slope and prediction
对于一元函数，导数描述输入附近的斜率：
For a scalar function, the derivative describes the local slope:
真正用于工程预测的是一阶近似：
The engineering prediction is the first-order approximation:
例如 $f(x)=x^2+2x$ 在 $x=1.5$ 附近，$f'(1.5)=5$。若输入增加 $0.01$，输出大约增加 $0.05$；二阶项会决定近似误差。你应该先能说出这个预测，再写极限定义。

For $f(x)=x^2+2x$ at $x=1.5$, $f'(1.5)=5$. An input increase of $0.01$ predicts an output increase of about $0.05$; the second-order term determines the error. State this prediction before writing the limit definition.
$h$ 太大时，忽略的高阶项造成截断误差；$h$ 太小时，两次相近函数值相减会放大浮点舍入误差。误差曲线通常先下降后上升。这个“模型近似误差和数值误差的平衡”会在有限差分 Jacobian、梯度检查和仿真积分中反复出现。

With a large $h$, neglected higher-order terms cause truncation error. With a small $h$, subtracting nearly equal function values amplifies floating-point roundoff. The error usually decreases and then rises. This balance between approximation and numerical error returns in finite-difference Jacobians, gradient checks, and simulation integration.
3.3 多元函数：偏导、方向导数和 Jacobian 3.3 Multivariable functions: partial, directional, and Jacobian derivatives
当输入和输出都是向量，导数不再是一个数，而是一个线性映射。对 $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R^m$，在 $x$ 附近有
When both input and output are vectors, the derivative is a linear map rather than a scalar. For $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R^m$, near $x$

blocks.latex:
f(x+\Delta x)\approx f(x)+J_f(x)\Delta x,\qquad
  J_f(x)=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\in\mathbb R^{m\times n}.

blocks.text: 第 $j$ 列是只沿输入基方向 $e_j$ 改变时的输出变化；第 $i$ 行描述第 $i$ 个输出对所有输入分量的敏感度。这个列/行解释与第 2 章矩阵的解释完全一致。

Column $j$ is the output change caused by moving along input basis direction $e_j$; row $i$ describes the sensitivity of output $i$ to all input components. This is exactly the matrix interpretation from Chapter 2.
是沿方向 $v$ 的方向导数。它回答“如果我把关节速度设置为 $v$，末端瞬时速度是什么”，而不是“某个变量单独变化时会怎样”。
is the directional derivative along $v$. It answers “what instantaneous end-effector velocity results from joint velocity $v$?” rather than “what happens when one variable changes in isolation.”
3.4 2R 机械臂：从几何图得到正运动学 3.4 A 2R arm: deriving forward kinematics from geometry
考虑两个平面转动关节，连杆长度分别为 $l_1,l_2$，关节角为 $q_1,q_2$。第二根连杆的绝对方向是 $q_1+q_2$，所以末端位置是两条向量的和：
Consider a planar two-revolute-joint arm with link lengths $l_1,l_2$ and joint angles $q_1,q_2$. The absolute direction of the second link is $q_1+q_2$, so the end position is the sum of two vectors:
不要把这个式子当作需要背诵的“标准答案”。画出两根杆，分别写出它们在 $x,y$ 方向的投影，再相加。换一个关节约定时，符号可能变化，但几何推理不变。
Do not memorize this as a standard answer. Draw the two links, project each onto $x$ and $y$, and add them. Different joint conventions may change signs, but the geometric reasoning remains.

blocks.code:
def fk_2r(q, link_lengths=(0.5, 0.35)):
    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
    if q.shape != (2,):
        raise ValueError(f"q must have shape (2,), got {q.shape}")
    l1, l2 = link_lengths
    q1, q2 = q
    q12 = q1 + q2
    return np.array([
        l1*np.cos(q1) + l2*np.cos(q12),
        l1*np.sin(q1) + l2*np.sin(q12),
    ])

blocks.text: 3.5 解析推导 Jacobian：每一列是一个关节的局部作用 3.5 Deriving the Jacobian: each column is one joint's local effect
对 $p(q)$ 分别对 $q_1,q_2$ 求偏导：
Differentiate $p(q)$ with respect to $q_1$ and $q_2$:

blocks.latex:
J(q)=\frac{\partial p}{\partial q}=
\begin{bmatrix}
-l_1\sin q_1-l_2\sin(q_1+q_2) & -l_2\sin(q_1+q_2)\\
l_1\cos q_1+l_2\cos(q_1+q_2) & l_2\cos(q_1+q_2)
\end{bmatrix}.

blocks.text: 第一列包含两根连杆，因为 $q_1$ 会同时旋转它们；第二列只包含第二根连杆，因为 $q_2$ 只改变第二个相对角。这个物理解释比“把公式抄进矩阵”更重要。

The first column contains both links because $q_1$ rotates both; the second contains only the second link because $q_2$ changes only the relative angle. This physical interpretation matters more than copying the formula into a matrix.

blocks.title: 用一列回答一个控制问题 One column answers one control question

blocks.text: 若 $q=[0.4,-0.7]^T$，取 $\dot q=[0.2,-0.1]^T$ rad/s，则 $J(q)\dot q$ 是末端的瞬时线速度。若只把 $\dot q_1$ 设为非零，$J$ 的第一列直接告诉你末端沿哪一个方向运动；这就是速度层控制器和视觉伺服中“列的意义”。
3.6 链式法则：从局部坐标到复杂模型 3.6 The chain rule: from local coordinates to complex models
机器人系统通常是多个函数的组合：传感器先把状态变成特征，策略再把特征变成动作，控制器再把动作变成关节命令。若 $z=g(x)$、$y=f(z)$，则
Robotic systems are compositions: a sensor maps state to features, a policy maps features to actions, and a controller maps actions to joint commands. If $z=g(x)$ and $y=f(z)$, then

blocks.latex:
\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}
  =\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}.

blocks.text: 这解释了两件事。第一，神经网络的反向传播不是新的魔法，而是链式法则在计算图上的组织方式。第二，机器人变换链和坐标链也需要保持中间空间匹配；把一个 frame 的 Jacobian 直接与另一个 frame 的速度相乘，就像把不同维度的链式法则拼错了。

This explains two things. First, backpropagation is the chain rule organized on a computation graph, not a new kind of magic. Second, robot transform and Jacobian chains must match intermediate spaces; multiplying a Jacobian in one frame by a velocity in another is a malformed chain rule.
3.7 用有限差分验证 Jacobian：验证近似而非只验证代码 3.7 Verify the Jacobian with finite differences: test the approximation
解析推导给出
The analytic derivation gives
验证时要同时关注三件事：步长是否足够小、误差是否随步长呈一阶下降、在奇异姿态附近是否出现数值敏感。单独比较一个输出数组，只能证明某一次调用没有崩溃。

A verification should track three things: whether the step is small enough, whether the error decreases with the step, and whether numerical sensitivity appears near singular configurations. Comparing one output array only proves that one call did not crash.

blocks.code:
def jacobian_2r(q, link_lengths=(0.5, 0.35)):
    q1, q2 = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
    l1, l2 = link_lengths
    s12, c12 = np.sin(q1+q2), np.cos(q1+q2)
    return np.array([
        [-l1*np.sin(q1)-l2*s12, -l2*s12],
        [ l1*np.cos(q1)+l2*c12,  l2*c12],
    ])

def finite_difference_jacobian(q, h=1e-6):
    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
    result = np.empty((2, 2))
    for j in range(2):
        direction = np.zeros(2)
        direction[j] = h
        result[:, j] = (fk_2r(q+direction)-fk_2r(q-direction))/(2*h)
    return result

q = np.array([0.4, -0.7])
analytic = jacobian_2r(q)
numerical = finite_difference_jacobian(q)
assert np.linalg.norm(analytic-numerical) < 1e-8

blocks.text: 3.8 奇异性与条件数：哪些末端方向难以实现 3.8 Singularity and conditioning: which task directions are difficult
当 $J$ 的列接近线性相关时，两个关节的作用方向几乎相同，机械臂难以独立地产生某些末端方向。二维 2R 机械臂的行列式为
When the columns of $J$ become nearly linearly dependent, the two joint effects point in nearly the same direction and some end-effector motions become difficult. For the planar 2R arm,
因此 $q_2=0$ 或 $\pi$ 时机械臂伸直或折叠，Jacobian 奇异。数值上更稳健的指标是奇异值 $\sigma_{\max},\sigma_{\min}$ 和条件数 $\kappa=\sigma_{\max}/\sigma_{\min}$。它们可以作为控制器的安全监控量。

Thus the arm is singular when $q_2=0$ or $\pi$, where it is straight or folded. Numerically, singular values $\sigma_{\max},\sigma_{\min}$ and the condition number $\kappa=\sigma_{\max}/\sigma_{\min}$ are more robust indicators. They can be monitored as controller safety signals.

blocks.title: 奇异性不是“代码算错” A singularity is not a coding bug

blocks.text: 在奇异位形附近，逆 Jacobian 可能把一个很小的末端速度要求转换成极大的关节速度。把速度上限简单调大，会把几何不可控性变成真实碰撞风险。正确做法是降低任务速度、使用阻尼伪逆、改变姿态或重新规划。

Near a singularity, the inverse Jacobian may turn a small Cartesian velocity request into huge joint velocities. Increasing speed limits turns geometric uncontrollability into collision risk. Reduce task speed, use a damped pseudoinverse, change the posture, or replan.
3.9 逆微分运动学：从末端速度到关节速度 3.9 Inverse differential kinematics: from task velocity to joint velocity
若目标是实现末端速度 $v$，理想关系为 $J\dot q=v$。当 $J$ 可逆时可写成 $\dot q=J^{-1}v$；更一般地使用 Moore--Penrose 伪逆 $J^\dagger$：
To achieve a task velocity $v$, the ideal relation is $J\dot q=v$. If $J$ is invertible, $\dot q=J^{-1}v$; more generally use the Moore--Penrose pseudoinverse $J^\dagger$:
接近奇异时使用阻尼伪逆：
Near a singularity use a damped pseudoinverse:
阻尼带来偏差，但限制了速度放大。$\lambda$ 不是越大越安全：它会降低任务跟踪精度；应根据奇异值、关节速度上限和任务容差调度。

Damping introduces bias but limits velocity amplification. A larger $\lambda$ is not always safer because it reduces task tracking accuracy. Schedule it from singular values, joint speed limits, and task tolerance.
3.10 把速度映射成控制实验：离散时间与安全边界 3.10 Turn the rate map into a control experiment: discrete time and safety
速度层控制器还不是完整控制系统。离散时间实现需要采样周期 $\Delta t$：
A rate-level controller is not yet a complete control system. A discrete implementation needs a sampling period $\Delta t$:
一个最小的到点控制器设末端误差 $e=p_{goal}-p(q)$，请求速度 $v=K e$，再用阻尼伪逆得到 $\dot q$。它必须额外检查关节限位、速度限幅、碰撞和奇异性。
A minimal point controller sets $e=p_{goal}-p(q)$, requests $v=Ke$, and maps it through the damped pseudoinverse. It must additionally check joint limits, speed clipping, collisions, and singularity.

blocks.code:
def move_to_target(q0, target, steps=500, dt=0.01):
    q = np.asarray(q0, dtype=float).copy()
    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
    history = []
    for _ in range(steps):
        position = fk_2r(q)
        error = target - position
        history.append((q.copy(), position.copy(), error.copy()))
        if np.linalg.norm(error) < 1e-4:
            break
        velocity = 3.0 * error
        qdot, _, condition = resolved_rate_step(
            q, velocity, damping=0.02, max_joint_speed=1.0)
        if condition > 1e3:
            raise RuntimeError("near-singular configuration")
        q = q + dt*qdot
        q = np.clip(q, [-np.pi, -np.pi], [np.pi, np.pi])
    return q, history

blocks.text: 这个实验的失败并不等同于“Jacobian 方法无效”。要记录失败发生在：目标不可达、初始位形奇异、速度被限幅、关节限位、时间步过大，还是测量噪声。研究报告应将这些原因分开。

Failure in this experiment does not mean the Jacobian method is invalid. Record whether failure came from an unreachable target, a singular start, speed clipping, joint limits, or a large time step. A research report should separate these causes.
3.11 自动微分与梯度检查：机器人和机器学习的共同语言 3.11 Automatic differentiation and gradient checks: a shared language
自动微分通过计算图和链式法则得到导数；它与符号推导不同，也不是有限差分。有限差分仍然重要，因为它可以作为独立的数值 sanity check。对一个新写的损失或 Jacobian，先在小尺寸、固定输入上比较自动微分和有限差分，再训练或控制。

Automatic differentiation obtains derivatives from a computation graph using the chain rule; it is not symbolic differentiation and is not finite differences. Finite differences remain valuable as an independent numerical sanity check. For a new loss or Jacobian, compare autodiff and finite differences on small fixed inputs before training or control.

blocks.code:
import torch

q = torch.tensor([0.4, -0.7], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
l1, l2 = 0.5, 0.35
position = torch.stack((
    l1*torch.cos(q[0]) + l2*torch.cos(q[0]+q[1]),
    l1*torch.sin(q[0]) + l2*torch.sin(q[0]+q[1]),
))
loss = (position**2).sum()
gradient, = torch.autograd.grad(loss, q)
assert gradient.shape == (2,)

blocks.text: 如果自动微分结果和解析式不一致，优先检查张量形状、广播、角度单位、是否意外 detach，以及损失是否真的对应你想优化的物理量。不要把“能反向传播”误认为“梯度正确”。

If autodiff disagrees with the analytic expression, first check tensor shapes, broadcasting, angle units, accidental detachment, and whether the loss is the intended physical quantity. “It backpropagates” does not mean “the gradient is correct.”
3.12 失败案例：导数正确但系统仍然失败 3.12 Failure cases: a correct derivative can still fail

items: 局部线性化超出范围：步长太大时，$J(q)\Delta q$ 不再代表真实位移；需要重新线性化或缩小步长。 Local model out of range: a large step invalidates $J(q)\Delta q$; relinearize or reduce the step.
frame 不一致：用基座 frame 的 $J$ 乘工具 frame 的速度；数值可能稳定，物理方向错误。 Frame mismatch: multiplying a base-frame Jacobian by a tool-frame velocity can be numerically stable but physically wrong.
单位不一致：$q$ 用度、三角函数用弧度；或位置用 mm、Jacobian 以 m/rad 计算。 Unit mismatch: degrees may enter a radian function, or mm may enter an m/rad Jacobian.
奇异性：伪逆放大噪声和速度；需要阻尼、限幅和姿态规划。 Singularity: a pseudoinverse amplifies noise and speed; use damping, limits, or posture planning.
离散化不稳定：连续时间的好控制律在过大的 $\Delta t$ 下可能发散。 Discrete instability: a good continuous-time law may diverge with a large $\Delta t$.
目标不可达：在工作空间外只能折中，不能把不可达变成可达。 Unreachable: outside the workspace, control can only compromise.

blocks.title: 诊断顺序 A diagnostic order

blocks.text: 先做单位和 frame 检查；再用可手算的姿态检查正运动学；再比较解析与有限差分 Jacobian；然后观察奇异值和关节速度；最后才调整控制增益或网络结构。这个顺序能避免把几何接口错误伪装成“需要更强 AI”。

Check units and frames first; verify forward kinematics on a hand-computable pose; compare analytic and finite-difference Jacobians; inspect singular values and speed; only then tune gains or network structure.
3.13 练习与答案骨架 3.13 Exercises and answer skeletons

items: 画出 2R 机械臂，分别写出两根连杆对末端 $x,y$ 的贡献，推导正运动学。 Draw a 2R arm, write both link contributions to $x,y$, and derive forward kinematics.
用链式法则解释为什么第一列 Jacobian 包含两根连杆，而第二列只包含第二根。 Use the chain rule to explain why column one contains both links while column two contains only link two.
证明 $\det J=l_1l_2\sin q_2$；指出哪些姿态奇异。 Prove $\det J=l_1l_2\sin q_2$ and identify the singular postures.
扫描 $h=10^{-2},10^{-4},10^{-6},10^{-8}$，比较有限差分误差。 Sweep four $h$ values and compare finite-difference errors.
对一个接近伸直的姿态，比较普通伪逆与阻尼伪逆产生的关节速度。 Near a straight posture, compare joint speeds from the ordinary and damped pseudoinverses.
将点控制器的比例增益从 1、3、10 扫描，分别报告到达时间、最大关节速度和稳态误差。 Sweep point-controller gains 1, 3, and 10; report time, peak joint speed, and steady error.
解释为什么在不同 frame 中表达的速度不能直接与同一个 Jacobian 相乘。 Explain why velocities in different frames cannot be multiplied by the same Jacobian.
设计一个自动微分、解析 Jacobian、有限差分三者互相核验的测试协议。 Design a protocol cross-checking autodiff, analytic, and finite-difference Jacobians.
两个投影向量相加；第二杆绝对角为 $q_1+q_2$。 Add the two link projections; link two has absolute angle $q_1+q_2$.
$q_1$ 改变两根杆的方向，$q_2$ 只改变第二根杆。 $q_1$ changes both link directions; $q_2$ changes only the second link.
展开行列式并用 $\sin(a-b)$ 化简，得到 $l_1l_2\sin q_2$。 Expand the determinant and use $\sin(a-b)$ to obtain $l_1l_2\sin q_2$.
中心差分在中等步长通常最稳定；极小步长受舍入误差影响。 Central differences are often best at an intermediate step; tiny steps suffer roundoff.
普通伪逆在最小奇异值接近 0 时速度爆炸；阻尼牺牲部分跟踪以换取有界性。 The ordinary pseudoinverse explodes when the smallest singular value approaches zero; damping trades tracking for boundedness.
增益提高通常加快收敛但增加限幅、振荡和噪声敏感性；必须报告控制周期和边界。 Higher gains may accelerate convergence but increase clipping, oscillation, and noise sensitivity; report period and limits.
Jacobian 的列和速度分量必须在同一 frame，且单位匹配。 Jacobian columns and velocity components must share a frame and matching units.
在固定 $q$、固定 dtype 和容差下，比较矩阵范数误差，并用多个随机姿态重复。 At fixed $q$, dtype, and tolerance, compare matrix-norm errors over several random postures.

blocks.title: 口述模板：Jacobian 在机器人里做什么？ Oral template: what does a Jacobian do in robotics?

blocks.text: Jacobian 是正运动学在当前构型附近的一阶线性近似。它的第 $j$ 列表示第 $j$ 个关节速度对末端速度的局部贡献，因此 $\dot p=J(q)\dot q$。如果 Jacobian 接近奇异，某些任务方向需要很大的关节速度，控制器必须使用阻尼、限幅或重新规划。

The Jacobian is the first-order local linearization of forward kinematics. Column $j$ is the local end-effector velocity contribution of joint $j$, so $\dot p=J(q)\dot q$. Near a singularity, some task directions require very large joint velocities, so the controller needs damping, limits, or replanning.
3.15 跨 Part 线性化证据：不要只相信 $J\delta q$ 3.15 Cross-Part linearization evidence: do not merely trust $J\delta q$
到这里，导数和 Jacobian 不应只停留在“能写出公式”。它们给出的是一个局部模型：在当前 $q$ 附近，用 $J(q)\delta q$ 预测真实的末端位移。研究级使用必须再问一句：这个局部模型在多大的步长、哪个姿态和哪个任务方向上仍可信？因此本节把“Taylor 余项”变成可测量的证据，而不是一句抽象的高阶小量。

At this point, a derivative or Jacobian should not remain a formula that can merely be written down. It is a local model: near the current $q$, $J(q)\delta q$ predicts the actual endpoint displacement. Research use asks one more question: for which step sizes, postures, and task directions is that local model trustworthy? This section turns the Taylor remainder into measurable evidence rather than an abstract higher-order term.
对光滑的正运动学和非退化方向，残差的绝对量级通常是 $O(h^2)$，而相对误差通常是 $O(h)$。这不是“任何代码都必须得到斜率 1”的承诺：靠近奇异位形、触碰角度分支、发生限幅或混入噪声后，斜率会改变。我们要报告的是观测到的斜率、末端残差（m）、步长（rad）和 $\sigma_{\min}(J)$（m/rad），并说明它们的适用范围。

For smooth forward kinematics and a non-degenerate direction, the absolute remainder is usually $O(h^2)$ and the relative error is usually $O(h)$. This is not a promise that every implementation must produce slope one: near singular postures, angle branches, clipping, or noise can change the slope. Report the observed slope, endpoint residual (m), step (rad), and $\sigma_{\min}(J)$ (m/rad), together with the validity range.

blocks.title: 2R 手算与证据 / Hand calculation and evidence for a 2R arm

blocks.text: 取 $q=[0.4,-0.7]$ rad、方向 $v=[1,-0.4]/\|[1,-0.4]\|$。对 $h=0.1$ rad，实验得到实际位移约 $0.062416$ m、线性预测约 $0.062610$ m、残差 $0.002590$ m、相对误差 $0.04150$；对 $h=0.001$ rad，残差降为 $2.59\times10^{-7}$ m、相对误差 $4.14\times10^{-4}$。五个步长的 log--log 观测斜率为约 $1.0003$，同时 $\sigma_{\min}=0.1306$ m/rad、条件数约 $6.61$。这个例子说明“步长缩小”和“姿态不病态”是两个不同的证据维度。

Take $q=[0.4,-0.7]$ rad and $v=[1,-0.4]/\|[1,-0.4]\|$. At $h=0.1$ rad, the actual displacement is about $0.062416$ m, the linear prediction $0.062610$ m, the residual $0.002590$ m, and the relative error $0.04150$. At $h=0.001$ rad, the residual falls to $2.59\times10^{-7}$ m and the relative error to $4.14\times10^{-4}$. The log--log slope over five steps is about $1.0003$, while $\sigma_{\min}=0.1306$ m/rad and the condition number is about $6.61$. Shrinking the step and avoiding an ill-conditioned posture are two separate dimensions of evidence.

blocks.code:
from linearization_evidence_lab import (
    local_linearization_sweep, observed_relative_error_order,
    task_loss_report,
)

records = local_linearization_sweep(
    q=[0.4, -0.7], direction=[1.0, -0.4])
order = observed_relative_error_order(records)
assert order > 0.7                 # evidence, not a universal law
assert records[-1]["linearization_residual_m"] < 1e-5

report = task_loss_report([0.4, -0.7], target=[0.65, 0.15])
assert report["jacobian_m_per_rad"].shape == (2, 2)
assert report["gauss_newton_hessian_m2_per_rad2"].shape == (2, 2)

blocks.title: 同一个局部模型如何流向后续章节 / How the same local model flows forward

blocks.text: 第 29 章的 MPC 不能只把线性化写成 $A_k,B_k$；应根据残差随 $h$ 的增长选择重线性化频率、预测窗口和 trust region。第 39 章的 image Jacobian 也要用同样的思路校准“像素变化—末端速度”的局部半径，并与观测年龄、协方差和最小奇异值共同决定是否伺服。第 69 章的 Gauss--Newton Hessian $J^TJ$ 则把同一 Jacobian 变成损失曲率，提示哪些方向容易被数据或几何放大。

Chapter 29's MPC should not merely write down $A_k,B_k$; use the residual growth with $h$ to choose relinearization frequency, prediction horizon, and trust-region radius. Chapter 39's image Jacobian needs the same calibration for the local radius of “pixel change versus endpoint velocity”, combined with observation age, covariance, and the minimum singular value to decide whether to servo. Chapter 69's Gauss--Newton Hessian $J^TJ$ turns the same Jacobian into loss curvature and reveals directions amplified by data or geometry.

blocks.title: 一次小步验证不等于全局可信 / One small-step check is not global validity

blocks.text: 如果只在一个 $q$、一个方向和一个 $h$ 上测到误差很小，就不能宣称控制器或 MPC 的线性模型在整个装配空间都可靠。至少要改变姿态、方向、步长、frame 和噪声；在接触模式切换、关节限位、角度 wrap 或视觉遮挡处单独标记失败。近奇异时即使 Taylor 残差很小，$J^\dagger$ 仍可能放大速度和噪声；这就是“局部近似误差”和“逆问题条件数”必须同时报告的原因。

A small error at one posture, direction, and step does not establish global validity for a controller or MPC model. Vary posture, direction, step, frame, and noise; label contact-mode switches, joint limits, angle wrapping, and visual occlusion separately. Near a singularity, the Taylor residual may be small while $J^\dagger$ still amplifies speed and noise. That is why local-approximation error and inverse-problem conditioning must be reported together.

blocks.title: 本节练习与答案提示 / Exercises and answer cues

items: 为什么相对误差的理论阶数通常比绝对残差低一阶？ Why is the theoretical order of relative error usually one lower than that of the absolute residual?
把 $q=[0,0]$ 的 2R 姿态加入扫描，比较 $\sigma_{\min}$、条件数和误差斜率。 Add $q=[0,0]$ to the sweep and compare $\sigma_{\min}$, condition number, and error slope.
说明为什么 MPC 应在模型残差超出阈值时重新线性化，而不是只增加求解器迭代次数。 Explain why MPC should relinearize when model residual exceeds a threshold instead of merely increasing solver iterations.

blocks.text: 答案提示：实际位移是一阶量而 Taylor 余项是二阶量；直臂姿态的 $\sigma_{\min}$ 接近零，逆映射会病态；求解器只能更精确地求解错误的局部模型，不能修复模型范围失效。

Answer cues: actual displacement is first order while the Taylor remainder is second order; the straight posture has nearly zero $\sigma_{\min}$ and an ill-conditioned inverse; a solver can solve a wrong local model more accurately but cannot repair an invalid model range.
3.16 本章完成标准与研究出口 3.16 Completion standard and research exit

最低证据：手算 2R 正运动学的一项；解释 Jacobian 每一列；运行解析/有限差分对比；运行 `test_linearization_evidence_lab.py` 并报告相对误差阶数；在奇异姿态运行阻尼伪逆；记录一个控制器失败原因；用中英文解释 Jacobian、单位和奇异性。 Minimum evidence: hand-derive one term of 2R forward kinematics; explain each Jacobian column; run the analytic/finite-difference comparison; run `test_linearization_evidence_lab.py` and report the observed relative-error order; run a damped pseudoinverse near a singular pose; record one controller failure cause; and explain Jacobians, units, and singularities in Chinese and English.

把第 2 章的 frame-aware 变换和本章的 Jacobian 接到一个 2R 末端到点实验：输入目标位置、输出轨迹、末端误差、最大关节速度、最小奇异值和失败原因。改变目标、初始姿态、噪声和控制周期，形成一张可复现的条件表。 Connect the frame-aware transform from Chapter 2 to this Jacobian in a 2R point-reaching experiment. Record the target, trajectory, end-effector error, peak joint speed, smallest singular value, and failure cause across targets, postures, noise, and control periods.
